Name: OmniEdge
Author: atudota
Description:
[color=#9900ff][size=5][b]Omni Edge[/b][/size][/color]
[b]purchased at JoJo Market[/b]
Introducing the Omni Edge: an iridium pickaxe, an iridium axe, and a powerful melee weapon all in one inventory slot. It utilizes the game's built-in weapon and tool interactions.

[b]Default stats[/b]
[list]
[*]Buy from JojaMart or Clint's Blacksmith shop for [b]250,000g[/b].[/*]
[*][b]80–110 base weapon damage[/b], +2 speed and +2 defense.[/*]
[*]Iridium-tier mining and chopping.[/*]
[*]No energy cost when using its tool effects.[/*]
[*]The item is protected from the normal lost-items-on-death selection.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Four modes[/b]
Equip Omni Edge and press [b]V[/b] to cycle:
[list]
[*][b]Auto[/b]: adds a pickaxe hit to a targeted breakable rock, or an axe hit to a targeted tree or matching resource clump. It does not apply a pickaxe/axe hit to ordinary chests, machines or growing crops.[/*]
[*][b]Mining[/b]: applies a normal iridium pickaxe action to the target tile.[/*]
[*][b]Chopping[/b]: applies a normal iridium axe action to the target tile.[/*]
[*][b]Combat[/b]: regular weapon behavior without an extra mining/chopping action.[/*]
[/list][b]Requirements[/b]
Stardew Valley 1.6.15 for desktop and SMAPI 4.5.2 or later.
